leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the createContext function from React to initialize a ThemeContext for managing theme state.
Define a ThemeProvider component that wraps children and controls theme data flow.
Implement useState to store and update the current theme value within the provider.
Construct a custom hook (useTheme) to access theme context values in child components.
Utilize the useContext hook to retrieve theme data from the nearest ThemeProvider.
Execute conditional rendering based on theme state to apply different CSS classes or styles.
Modify theme state through handler functions that toggle between light and dark modes.
Assign default theme values and TypeScript types to ensure type safety across the context.
Control component behavior by passing theme state and update functions through context value.
Access theme context in multiple components to demonstrate centralized state management.
Return appropriate JSX structure from the ThemeProvider that renders children with context.
Handle theme changes by wiring UI elements (buttons, toggles) to context update functions.
